  "summary": "The requirement SFMC-REQ-029 specifies that the mission fault log must record key fault details including identifier, affected subsystem, detection time, and description. This is a clear, verifiable software requirement consistent with fault management best practices described in NASA-HDBK-2203-5.09 §3.2.1.9, which emphasizes fault logging with timestamps and relevant details. The SRS provides supporting context in section 3.6 Vehicle Health Monitoring, including related requirements SFMC-REQ-028 and SFMC-REQ-027, confirming software responsibility for fault recording and display. The requirement is well-written, unambiguous, and testable. No software allocation issues are identified. No direct NPR SWE linkage is justified as the NPR passages focus on requirements management rather than specific fault management content."
